Blake Corum is the Rams’ best running back. Blake Corum was incredible for the Los Angeles Rams in their Week 12 win over the Green Bay Packers. He was nearly unstoppable as he gashed through the Green Bay defense, carrying the offense in a 26-13 victory. Not only was Corum the best player in the ga

Tonight, Blake Corum started seeing neutral to heavy boxes very early in the game, eventually seeing a seven-man box on half his carries and an 8-plus man box on 14. 

He still rushed for 177 yards and a touchdown when facing those scenarios. 

(Per NextGenStats)

The baton was there for him. And he has taken it and run like a mad man.
